rules.rule: Publisher-derived case facts are external partial labels, not complete expert ground truth.
Never infer that missing candidate rows or source unavailability implies no rights or safe transaction.
No names, addresses, ID numbers, full PDF texts, downloaded PDF bytes, or uploaded source screenshots persisted to Git.
Only publisher-listed educational examples are deterministic expectation sources; official guidance supports definitions/checklists, not sample-level PDF goldens.
